Package org.jdesktop.lg3d.apps.texteditor

Class TextFileIO

java.lang.Object
org.jdesktop.lg3d.apps.texteditor.TextFileIO
public final class TextFileIO extends Object
The Advanced Text Editor's safe file layer. Loading and saving are the two places where an editor can hurt a user, so both ends are hardened:
  • Load guards — a size ceiling (MAX_OPEN_BYTES) keeps multi-gigabyte files from exhausting the heap, and a NUL sniff over the first bytes rejects binaries with a clear message instead of showing mojibake.
  • Charset handling — a UTF-8 / UTF-16 byte-order mark wins when present; otherwise the bytes are decoded strictly as UTF-8 and, only if that fails, leniently as ISO-8859-1 with a user-visible warning. Nothing is ever decoded silently-lossily as UTF-8.
  • Line endings — detected per file (CRLF vs LF) and normalised to '\n' in memory; the file's own convention is restored on save so diffs stay clean.
  • Atomic save — bytes go to a sibling temp file which is then moved over the target with ATOMIC_MOVE (falling back to a plain replace on file systems that cannot do atomic moves), with the target's POSIX permissions copied onto the temp file first. A crash mid-save can therefore never leave a half-written original, and a saved file never becomes world-readable by accident.
